SELECT v.id,v.application_no,v.submit_request_id,v.user_id,v.school_name,v.student_card_urls,v.id_card_last4,v.verification_status,v.reject_reason,v.reviewed_by_admin_user_id,v.submitted_at,v.material_consent_version,v.material_consent_at,v.reviewed_at,v.expire_at,v.version,v.created_at,v.updated_at FROM user_student_verification v WHERE v.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id,v.application_no,v.submit_request_id,v.user_id,v.school_name,v.student_card_urls,v.id_card_last4,v.verification_status,v.reject_reason,v.reviewed_by_admin_user_id,v.submitted_at,v.material_consent_version,v.material_consent_at,v.reviewed_at,v.expire_at,v.version,v.created_at,v.updated_at FROM user_student_verification v WHERE v.submit_request_id=#{key}

SELECT v.id,v.application_no,v.submit_request_id,v.user_id,v.school_name,v.student_card_urls,v.id_card_last4,v.verification_status,v.reject_reason,v.reviewed_by_admin_user_id,v.submitted_at,v.material_consent_version,v.material_consent_at,v.reviewed_at,v.expire_at,v.version,v.created_at,v.updated_at FROM user_student_verification v WHERE v.user_id=#{user} ORDER BY CASE WHEN verification_status='pending' THEN 0 WHEN verification_status='approved' AND expire_at>#{now} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,submitted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,user_id FROM user_student_verification WHERE verification_status='approved' AND expire_at<=#{now} ORDER BY expire_at,id LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM user_student_verification WHERE user_id=#{user} AND verification_status='approved' AND expire_at<=#{now} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_student_verification SET verification_status='expired',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND verification_status='approved' AND version=#{version} AND expire_at<=#{now}

UPDATE user_student_verification SET verification_status=#{status},reviewed_by_admin_user_id=#{actor},reviewed_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1,reject_reason=CASE WHEN #{status}='rejected' THEN #{remark} ELSE NULL END,expire_at=#{expiry} WHERE id=#{id} AND verification_status='pending' AND version=#{version}
